entries.note: Tool implementation lives in a replaceable process behind the stable facade. Resolve only a validated runtime descriptor for the original host, retain the original root and reject foreign sessions/desktops before each operation. Probe/update/status never launches a coding conversation. The existing eight-tool connector can remain running while an agent uses runtime/client.mjs with its original context.

anchor.snippet: const windowCapability = state => { if (state.capabilities.projectWindows !== 1) throw new Error('Project-window control needs the current runtime supervisor. Use the documented context-bound bootstrap.'); };

entries.note: New window and report tools retain the connector’s captured root. Opening a window attaches an existing root-bound agent; only the recorded origin/project pair can inspect its window or exchange reports. The origin can explicitly view its linked project inbox or attribute its own project-side observation without claiming another agent wrote it.

anchor.snippet: const scriptCapability = state => { if (state.capabilities.scriptActions !== 1) throw new Error('Update the workspace worker before opening script tabs.'); };

entries.note: Script execution is effectful and not idempotent; root-bound tools require an explicit script path, literal argv and a target desktop. View attachment failure returns a retained process identity. show_session attaches that process without another execution, and ordinary stop_session remains the explicit termination action.
